entries.def:
ὑπο-βάλλω 
[in LXX: ??Dan.3.9 A, I Est.2.18 * ;] 
to throw or put under. Metaphorical, 
__(a) to subject, submit; 
__(b) to suggest, whisper, prompt; 
__(with) to suborn (see Field, Notes, 113), instigate: with accusative of person(s), Act.6.11.†
(AS)

ὑπογραμμός, -οῦ, ὁ
(ὑπογράφω, (a) to write under; (b) to trace letters for copying), [in LXX: 2Ma.2.28 * ;] 
__1. a writing-copy, hence, 
__2. an example: 1Pe.2.11 (Philo).†
(AS)

ὑπό-δειγμα, -τος, τό
(ὑποδείκνυμι), [in LXX: Ezk.42.15, Sir.44.16, 2Ma.6.28 2Mac.6.31, 4Ma.17.23 * ;] 
used by later writers (Xen. onwards) for παράδειγμα (see Rutherford, NPhr., 62), 
__(a) a figure, copy: Heb.8.5; 9.23; 
__(b) an example: for imitation, Jhn.13.15, Jas.5.10; for warning, Heb.4.11, 2Pe.2.6.†
SYN.: ὁμοίωμα, τύπος, ὑποτύπωσις (see DB, iii. 696b) (AS)

ὑπο-δείκνυμι 
[in LXX for נָגַד hi., etc. ;] 
__1. to show secretly. 
__2. to show by tracing out; hence, generally, to teach, make known: with dative of person(s), Luk.6.47; 12.5, Act.9.16; id. with inf., Mat.3.7, Luk.3.7; before, ὅτι, Act.20.35.†
(AS)

ὑπο-δέχομαι 
[in LXX: Tob.7.8-9 Jdt.13.13 A, 1Ma.16.15, 4Ma.13.17 * ;] 
to receive under one's roof, receive as a guest, entertain hospitably: with accusative of person(s), Luk.19.6, Act.17.7, Jas.2.25; εἰς τ. οἶκον, Luk.10.38 (see MM, xxv).†
(AS)

ὑπο-δέω 
[in LXX: 2Ch.28.15, Ezk.16.10 (נָעַל) * ;] 
to blind under, esp. of foot gear. Most frequently in mid, and pass. with accusative; 
__(a) of the foot, ὑποδησάμενοι τ. πόδας, your feet shod: Eph.6.15 
__(b) of that which is put on, σανδάλια: Mrk.6.9, Act.12.8.†
(AS)

ὑπόδημα, -τος, τό
(ὑποδέω), [in LXX for נָעַל ;] 
a sole bound under the foot, a sandal: Mat.3.11; 10.10, Mrk.1.7, Luk.3.16; 10.4; 15.22; 22.35, Jhn.1.27; τ. ποδῶν, Act.7.33 (LXX) Act.13.25.†
SYN.: σανδάλιον, q.v (AS)

ὑπόδικος, -ον 
brought to trial, answerable to: with dative of person(s), τ. θεῷ, Rom.3.19 (see MM, xxv).†
(AS)

ὑπο-ζύγιος, -α, -ον 
[in LXX for חֲמוֹר ;] 
under the yoke; as subst., τ . (Hdt., al.), a beast of burden; colloq., an ass (see Deiss., BS, 160 f.), and so always in LXX and NT: Mat.21.5 (LXX), 2Pe.2.16.†
(AS)

ὑπο-ζώννυμι 
[in LXX: 2Ma.3.19 * ;] 
to undergird (Hdt., al.; ὑπὸ τ. μάστους, 2Mac, l.with); of a ship, to undergird or frap: Act.27.17 (see DB, ext. 367a).†
(AS)
